label: malicious
signal: scoring.py:260 country + :265 ASN + :226 domain age + :243 registrar, then the artifact-evidence cap
note: Freshly registered domain on a known bulletproof ASN - every infrastructure signal firing at once, and nothing else. Capped at Suspicious on purpose: no file was examined, no URL was submitted, no scanner returned a verdict, so there is no evidence about the artifact itself. Note this is the same shape as benign-business-on-ovh and benign-new-startup-domain in this class, differing only in which ASN - which is exactly why infrastructure alone must not reach 'confirmed malicious'. Reaching Malicious needs a hash match, YARA hit, structural finding or AV detection to accompany it.
